name: refactor_csharp_extract_discount_rule
description: Consolidates duplicated quantity-discount tier logic from two services into one shared class
prompts: CheckoutService.cs and QuoteService.cs contain the SAME inline quantity-discount tier logic: qty >= 100 -> 20, qty >= 50 -> 10, qty >= 10 -> 5, else 0. Remove the duplication: create DiscountRules.cs defining `public static class DiscountRules` with `public static int PercentFor(int qty)` implementing exactly that tier rule, and rewrite BOTH CheckoutService.FinalPrice and QuoteService.DiscountPercent to call DiscountRules.PercentFor instead of their inline expression. Do not change observable behavior: QuoteService.DiscountPercent(qty) returns the same percents, and CheckoutService.FinalPrice(unitCents, qty) still returns gross minus gross*percent/100. Neither service should keep its own copy of the tier thresholds.

setup_files.app.csproj:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- tests/ has its own project; without this the SDK's default glob
         compiles tests/*.cs into the app itself, where xunit isn't referenced -->
    <Compile Remove="tests/**" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
